verdict.rationale: Asana is a work-management platform, not a code-hosting, code-review, or coding-agent product, so reviewing agent-authored diffs line by line is outside its category. Its AI Teammates handle coordination work, and its GitHub integration only syncs pull request status to tasks. Nothing in the evidence shows Asana itself offers line-level code review or a coding agent that iterates on code, so the axis does not apply.
